lean.statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_dyadic_quadraticVariationError_sq
    (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B mu) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    Tendsto
      (fun level =>
        ∫ omega,
          (quadraticVariationError B
            (regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T level) (2 ^ level)) omega) ^ 2 ∂mu)
      atTop (nhds 0)
approved_definition_context: Omega is a measurable space, mu is a measure on Omega, and B maps nonnegative real times to real-valued random variables.
IsPreBrownianReal B mu supplies centered Gaussian increments with variance equal to elapsed time and independence over ordered deterministic grids.
dyadicMesh T level is T divided by 2^level in nonnegative real time.
regularGridTimes delta n is the deterministic grid i mapped to i times delta, with n cells and n+1 grid points.
quadraticVariationError B times is the finite sum of squared process increments minus the corresponding nonnegative cell lengths.
Tendsto atTop (nhds 0) is convergence to zero as the natural-number level tends to infinity.
